notes_for_editor: One source only: a coordinate list with no build date, height, staffing, fire or condition entry for Tate. Two web searches and the list read found nothing else about this tower. The record elevation_m 477.3 is the list's 1566 converted from feet; the list header was not in the text read, so the unit is inferred. The name Tate also belongs to the Pickens County village (a marble company town). A Digital Library of Georgia photo record (dlg_vang_pck005) concerns the village homestead, not the tower, and was not used. A search hit mentioned a 2022 brushfire on Firetower Road near Sharp Mountain in Pickens County; it was not read and does not confirm a tower, so it is a lead only. The story runs to about 120 words because the evidence is thin.
